scenes.prompt: The prehistoric stone carver taps the flint chisel with the hammerstone again and again, white chips and dust burst from the limestone with every blow, the workers behind him keep pecking the stone with their hammerstones. Slow push-in camera, golden hour light, dust drifting through the sun. Sounds of stone striking stone and wind. The tools are only a round grey river-cobble hammerstone held in the bare hand and a knapped flint chisel; there is no metal and no hammer with a handle anywhere in the shot. Photorealistic, cinematic, natural motion, Neolithic people in animal hides. No dialogue, no music, no subtitles.
